title: Synthetic household income-gap sensitivity
construction: For each calendar year, subtract the Black-alone household median from the non-Hispanic White-alone household median. Sum/compound as if a single synthetic household experienced this gap each year. THIS IS NOT TRACKED REAL HOUSEHOLDS AND NOT RESTITUTION OWED.
critical_caveats: Census medians use different household samples each year, so cannot follow an individual or establish cumulative loss
No adjustment for household composition, hours, age, education or other factors
Cohort definitions change at 2002; analysis intentionally starts there
The income series is in constant 2025 purchasing power; applying nominal interest without adjusting is invalid
The assumed 2% and 5% real rates are scenario growth rates, not statutory interest
Every year is different households at the median; collective sum is a purely synthetic benchmark
No identified claimant or defendant, no legal entitlement or damages
